text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I'm sorry, Trainer. I lost.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's frustrating to admit, but this is the best I can do right now…
choice_data_list: I know this isn't your full potential.
Let's regroup and give it another shot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh! What a nice way to put it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You're right. I haven't hit my limit yet! I'm still the epitome of ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm jumping back into training starting today! My first goal is to become a slightly better kind of ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna get good enough to get first place by the next race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's figure out what kind of training regimen we should do!
